title: AppShell dashboard webpack_require__.n dev crash
symptom: TypeError __webpack_require__.n is not a function on dashboard routes in AppShell.tsx dev
root_cause: Webpack dev HMR race on next/link default import interop
fix: Replaced Link with anchor + router.push; import type PropsWithChildren; cleared .next cache

title: Migration index references missing column
symptom: db push failed with SQLSTATE 42703 on learning_case_versions_status_idx
root_cause: Index targeted column domain that does not exist on learning_case_versions
fix: Changed index to use status, internal_level, case_id and re-ran db push
